title: Optimize quant kernels: INT8/FP8 smoothquant + dequant-fusion + KV-cache + batching improvements
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Improved INT8/FP8 quantized kernel throughput and reduced tail latency. Adds fused dequant+GEMM kernels and smoother FP8 path with smoothquant scaling. No API changes.
description: Motivation: reduce per-token CPU/GPU cost and tail latency for quantized model serving by moving common dequant and scaling work into fused kernels and tightening continuous-batching and KV-cache hot paths. Summary: Implement fused dequant+GEMM microkernels (INT8 and FP8), integrate smoothquant scaling into the FP8 path, add a fast-path for KV-cache reads that avoids locks in the common case, and add scheduler heuristics to more aggressively form small continuous batches for short-context workloads. Results: up to 1.8x throughput for INT8 causal-generation microbenchmarks, 1.5x for FP8 with smoothquant on typical chat workloads, and 10-18% end-to-end median latency reduction at 99th percentile traffic in our internal bench cluster. No external API changes. Checklist: - implement fused_dequant_gemm microkernel - add FP8 smoothquant scaling stage and FP8 GEMM path - add fallback and correctness tests against FP32 and reference kernels - update continuous batching heuristics and add metrics - KV-cache hotpath lockless read with compare-exchange fallback - add microbench and end-to-end perf CI tests - docs and changelog entries Changes are conservative: fallbacks to reference paths are provided when hardware lacks required ISA support or when models use unsupported quantization variants.

bench_results: Internal microbench on p4d-like nodes: INT8 fused kernel: 1.6-1.8x throughput vs previous int8 path for batch sizes 1-8; FP8 smoothquant path: 1.3-1.5x on chat workloads; KV-cache hotpath reduced avg KV read latency by 40% under contention; continuous batching heuristics improved token/s by 12% for short-turn dialogues.
notes_on_correctness: All fused kernels include fallbacks to reference dequant + GEMM when validity checks fail. Added 1000+ unit test vectors, cross-checked outputs against FP32 reference with relative tolerance 1e-3 for INT8 and 5e-3 for FP8 after scaling. Sanity runs on full model end-to-end verified no semantic regressions on sampled eval prompts.
